715300101.text: #Yo, Happy Lantern Rite, {M#my dude and dudette!}{F#dudettes!}

715300102.text: Say, you two wouldn't happen to be the bigshots who came looking for Gaming, would you?

715300103.text: We saw you before! You were hanging out with Gaming, right?

715300104.text: Totally! Hot diggity, you remember me! My luck's on fire!

715300105.text: I heard you two are the best of the best, and there ain't nothing you can't do! I pop on over to Chihu Rock to buy groceries every day, and even though it's so close by, I still always hear people singing your praises along the way.

715300108.text: H—Hey! Paimon's good at stuff besides eating, too!

715300109.text: Wait, let Paimon think for a moment... What else is she good at...

715300110.text: I've got it! Can ordinary people float? You're so white and light and fluffy, like a pigeon adeptus!

715300111.text: Flying alone is amazing. I mean, it should be super easy to carry stuff, and makes work a cinch! You should help your friend more.
